english.title: Indecent / racial chanting at a designated football match - Football (Offences) Act 1991
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), at a designated football match held at **(..SPECIFY GROUND..), engaged or took part in chanting of an indecent or racialist nature **(..SPECIFY CHANTING..)
english.legislation: Contrary to sections3(1) and 5 of the Football (Offences) Act 1991.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
while at designated football match
engage / took part in
indecent/racialist chanting

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Consider an application for a football banning order
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See section 3(2)(a) of the Football (Offences) Act 1991 for meaning of 'chanting' and note that this subsection has been amended by section 9(3) of the Football (Offences and Disorder) Act 1999 so that the offence may be committed by a defendant acting alone or with others.
(ii) See section 3(2)(b) for meaning of 'of a racialist nature'.
(iii) See the Football (Offences) (Designation of Football Matches) Order 2000, SI 2329/2000 for definition of a "designated" football match.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant, at a designated football match held at **(..SPECIFY GROUND..), engaged or took part in chanting of an indecent or racialist nature **(..SPECIFY CHANTING..).

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

maxfinetypemagct.description: fine not exceeding level three on the legislative standard scale
